name: docsort

scripts.dev: AUTH_MODE=none-i-understand-the-risk INCOMING_DIR=/tmp/docsort/incoming UPLOAD_DIR=/tmp/docsort/uploads OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/docsort/documents REVIEW_DIR=/tmp/docsort/documents/needs-review GRAVEYARD_DIR=/tmp/docsort/graveyard LOG_DIR=/tmp/docsort/documents/logs DB_PATH=/tmp/docsort/data/documents.db tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter docsort-frontend run build

description: Self-hosted document filing: scanned PDFs are classified by Claude, renamed and filed into folders, with a searchable web UI.
